_comment: Pre-registered evaluation protocol. Frozen before the first backtest run; do not adapt to results. Values marked start_value have no evidence behind them.

pandemic_exclusion.reason: Testing, closure and quarantine rules distort the series; not used for baselines, training or scoring.

seasons.definition: ISO week 40 to week 39 of the following year
seasons.test_rule: The test season is evaluated once; `backtest test` refuses to overwrite its result without --force.

vintage_note: Real data versions of ARE exist since 2023-09 (reconstructed from the RKI's public git history, data/long/are.csv.gz). The tuning and test backtests still use today's corrected data; a separate descriptive comparison with the data versions known at each origin is in forecasts/backtest/vintage.json.

ensemble.weight_status: start_value (v1: 0.5); v2 searches the grid on the tuning seasons

models.selection_rule: Feature set and ensemble weight/spread with the lowest ensemble WIS over the weight x spread grid on the tuning seasons.

peak_scoring: v2: per horizon, argmax of the centred 3-week mean over W45..W15 (week between the years and the week after removed) of the median forecast versus the actual values; median |timing error| in weeks and share within one week; persistence lags by about h weeks by construction (reference). v1 pooled all horizons and weeks and was discontinuous.

gate.evaluated_on: test season, all regions and horizons

external_comparison_note: RESPINOW comparison (national, absolute counts converted to per 100k) is in forecasts/backtest/external.json; RespiCast was not reachable.

amendments.reason: A diagnosis on the tuning seasons only (2023/24, 2024/25) found a large, regular care-seeking calendar effect in ARE (week between the years about 0.4x, each closed weekday about 0.81x; absent in GrippeWeb) that the v1 model could not explain, a flawed peak-timing metric, and an inconsistency of the lag of wastewater features between training and prediction.
changes: Calendar adjustment: fixed log effect -1.175*closed_share - 0.356*[week contains 28 Dec], estimated on national ARE before 2023-W36 only; applied to the regional model (dynamics features, training target, forecast) and to the seasonal baseline (samples aligned to the target week).
Regional model: availability lags are now applied identically in training and prediction.
Ensemble weight of the regional model and spread factor are chosen jointly on the tuning seasons from grids (weights 0.5/0.6/0.75, the existing spread grid); the feature candidates are unchanged.
Peak timing: per horizon, winter window W45..W15, centred 3-week mean, week between the years and the week after removed; share within one week reported; the persistence lag is the reference.
Gate reference is now the calendar-aligned seasonal baseline (stricter and also what is shipped on fallback); the plain v1 baseline is reported as 'baseline-plain'.
Vacation periods now cover 2012/13 onward (KMK PDFs), so the Christmas dips of earlier winters enter training with their calendar features.
amendments.test_season_status: Season 2025/26 was evaluated once under protocol v1 (forecasts/backtest/test-v1.json, untouched at that time). Under v2 it is evaluated again for description only and is no longer an untouched test season. The next untouched test season is 2026/27: evaluate it once after ISO week 2027-W39.
amendments.selection_data: Tuning seasons only; the v1 test-season results were not used to select anything in v2 (the diagnosis explicitly excluded season 2025/26).
